Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候有一个人叫神农。他需要当上医，一看别的人就想帮助他们。但是，他有一个问题，他不知道什么东西能做药。神农听说一个远远的地方有一种植物，什么病人吃都会觉得身体更好。神农三个月走去，找到有植物的地方，他看到一个很漂亮的植物，又香又好看。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 他需要当上医：医生
- 一看别的人就想帮助他们：看到，看look vs.看到see; 病人，“别的” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”
- 什么病人吃都会觉得身体更好：吃了以后
- 神农三个月走去：走了三个月

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，Both expressions refer to the same time period, so using them together is redundant. [teacher rule: gudai_de_shihou_why]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 当上医：当医生，医生 is the usual occupation noun here; 当上 indicates successfully attaining a role and does not fit the intended meaning of needing to work as a doctor. [rule: none]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 别的人：别人，别人 refers to other people as a group; 别的 is used to distinguish a different item or type. [teacher rule: bieren]
4. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 一看：一看到，The sentence means that he sees someone and then wants to help, so the resultative complement 到 is needed. [rule: resultative_complement]
5. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 什么病人吃都会觉得身体更好：什么病人吃了都会觉得身体更好，The eating happens before the patient feels better, so 了 marks the completed action. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
6. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 神农三个月走去，找到有植物的地方：神农走了三个月，找到了有植物的地方，Both the long walk and the finding are completed events in the narrative, so they need 了. [rule: aspect_le_completed]

items.reason: 古代 already denotes a time period, so 古代的时候 is redundant under the teacher's rule.
当上医 is not an appropriate occupation expression here; 当医生 is correct.
别人 removes the 别的 error but still means other people rather than the intended 病人.
The intended meaning is seeing someone, so 看到 is the required verb here.
吃了 alone does not fully make the required before-and-after relation; 吃了以后 is needed.
走了三个月 correctly places 了 and marks the completed walking and finding events.
